reason: Both files remove an ordinary non-unique index, but the patch only changes constraint disambiguation when a unique constraint exists on the same fields. Neither existing test constructs that competing unique constraint, so adding unique=False doesn't alter their result.

The patch adds OutputWrapper.flush() and delegates to the wrapped stream. The Django/unittest runner flushes its output wrapper during ordinary process lifecycle, so 725 unrelated test modules enter the method. No existing test references OutputWrapper or asserts propagation to the wrapped stream; these files don't observe the changed behavior.

The patch accepts duck-typed values with resolve_expression that aren't Expression subclasses. The two ordering files use primitive values and test_bulk_update.py uses built-in Django Expression subclasses (Lower/F/CombinedExpression); none supplies the newly supported duck-typed case.

The patch changes max() only when lastmod is callable and items() is empty. Existing callable-lastmod sitemap fixtures return non-empty lists; EmptySitemap has no lastmod attribute. Both files enter get_latest_lastmod but don't exercise the new empty iterable behavior.
